the convective overshoot can be described by the TCM in a simple way.
the convective overshouting can be well explained by the turbulent heat flux, which is the main mechanism of the convective transport.

the turbulent heat transfer in the overshooting zone is mainly due to the turbulent heat flux, not to the molecular heat conduction, and the convective overshoot can be well simulated with a simple model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the overshooting length is determined by the diffusion length of the turbulent kinetic-energy, the turbulent correlations are determined by the turbulent correlations at the convective-boundary and the decaying indices, and the decaying index of the turbulent heat transfer is determined by the decaying index and the anisotropic index.
